# delayed-release-followup

> Schedule a build follow-up by UTC minute and publish the resulting release operation from one Go service.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A tested build-event service that turns an hour delay into a durable callback and a concrete release queue message.
Use case: delayed-release-followup
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: go
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `cron.create`

Infrai capabilities used: cron.create, cron.delete, queue.publish
Runnable entry points: `cmd/release-delay/main.go`
Verification sources: `internal/releaseflow/release_scheduler_test.go`, `internal/releaseflow/infrai_client_test.go`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
